en: Add one-click registration of installed Codex plugins and import skill references from their actual installed versions.
Automatically check for new or updated plugins at startup, when returning to Prism, and every five minutes; honor manual removals and disabled or uninstalled plugins.
Show skill-reference availability separately from unverified tool connections and unsupported desktop tools. Sign-ins and permissions remain separate.
zh: 新增“一键接入本机已安装插件”，按实际安装版本登记插件并接入技能资料。
启动、返回窗口及每五分钟自动检查新增或更新插件，保留手动移除选择，排除停用和已卸载插件。
分别展示技能资料、待核验的工具连接与暂不支持的桌面工具；账号登录和工具权限仍独立管理。
